mechanism: Native mixed quantization (E16 x H16) with one Euclidean/hyperbolic weight per codeword, allocated by the TRAIN structural density of the items each codeword covers

computations.name: codeword cost
computations.text: For a residual (rE, rH) with rH in the ball and codeword k with halves (eE,k, eH,k): C_k = 2*(alpha_k*||rE - eE,k||^2 + (1 - alpha_k)*d_c(rH, eH,k)^2/4), with c = 1 and alpha_k from the codeword table.

computations.name: commitment and codebook terms
computations.text: Both use the chosen codeword's own weight, alpha_{k*}: commitment = C_{k*}(rE, rH; sg(eE), sg(eH)) and codebook = C_{k*}(sg(rE), sg(rH); eE, eH); quant_loss = (codebook + beta*commitment).mean()/32.

computations.name: residual update
computations.text: rE' = rE - sg(eE,k*) and rH' = project((-sg(eH,k*)) (+) rH); the readout is phi(q) = [sum_k eE,k, log_0(eH,1 (+) (eH,2 (+) eH,3))].

computations.name: per-item structural density
computations.text: On the TRAIN behaviour graph (consecutive history pairs plus history-tail to target, undirected, self-loops dropped) let t_e be the number of triangles through edge e and deg(i) the edge degree of item i. Then rho_i = (sum_{e incident to i} t_e) / deg(i).

computations.name: codeword allocation
computations.text: At level l and epoch e in {1, 101, 201, ...}: assign every TRAIN item with the current table, let d_k be the mean rho of the items assigned to codeword k, and let R_k be the average rank of d_k among the used codewords. Then alpha_k = ALPHA_MIN + (ALPHA_MAX - ALPHA_MIN) * R_k / (n_used - 1) for a used codeword, and POPULATION_ALPHA otherwise. Ties share a rank and therefore a weight.

inputs.density: per-item scalar rho_i over the 24556 training items

outputs.identifiers: three hard tokens per item, exported with the codeword table read from the checkpoint
outputs.code_alpha: 3 x 256 table, saved in the checkpoint (buffer and extra state) and used by the export

gradient_rules: The cost is differentiable in (rE, rH) and in the codeword halves; alpha_k is a constant with respect to every gradient.
The commitment term detaches the codeword and the codebook term detaches the residual, so the encoder and the codebook receive their own terms and nothing else.
The residual update detaches the chosen codeword.

training_integration.weight: the codeword table is refreshed at epoch 1 and every 100 epochs from the current hard assignment over the TRAIN items; no validation or test interaction is read
training_integration.export: model.get_indices uses the same table the last refresh wrote

conventions.readout: q = [sum eE, log_0(qH)], the same convention as the frozen F0 recipe
conventions.assignment: the baseline's own rule: nearest code on levels 1 and 2, balanced Sinkhorn on level 3 during training

switches.geometry_off: ALPHA_MODE = "global" keeps one constant weight for every codeword (the control tree TIGER_graphlet_codebook_global_rq); its arithmetic is identical to the frozen F0 recipe
switches.behaviour_off: a permutation of rho across items before the rank allocation destroys the structural signal while keeping the table's shape; it is defined by the same allocate() call on permuted input
switches.both_on: ALPHA_MODE = "codebook" on the measured rho (the trained arm)

excluded: the argmin / Sinkhorn choice: discrete, the baseline's rule
the straight-through decoder path: identity backward by construction
the codeword table and the density ranking: deterministic, no optimizer gradient
